item.title: Architecture & Data Contract
item.description:
The architecture is divided into a Data Lake path and a Serving path. The bridge between them is Lambda QMJ Loader: S3 creates new Parquet files, S3 sends an ObjectCreated event, and Lambda reads the file and writes items to DynamoDB.

Data Flow

Data Lake path
Sources → Backfill/Daily Ingestion → S3 Raw → Glue PySpark QMJ → S3 Processed

Serving path
S3 Processed -- ObjectCreated (*.parquet) --> Lambda QMJ Loader --> DynamoDB
DynamoDB --> Lambda Reader --> API Gateway --> Browser

Automation path
EventBridge Scheduler - - -→ Glue Python Shell Daily Ingestion

Data Contract

Dataset Grain Output location Consumer
us_prices_raw.parquet ticker + price_date raw_us_market/YYYY/MM/DD/ Glue PySpark QMJ
us_company_info.parquet ticker + snapshot_date raw_us_market/YYYY/MM/DD/ Glue PySpark QMJ
us_financials_raw.parquet ticker + report_date + period_type + snapshot_date raw_us_market/YYYY/MM/DD/ Glue PySpark QMJ
QMJ output Parquet One row per ticker at AS_OF_DATE processed_qmj/as_of_date=.../ Lambda QMJ Loader
DynamoDB item ticker + snapshot_date Table qmj_screener Lambda Reader

Architectural Principle – Event-Driven Serving. qmj_transform.py does not have PutItem or BatchWriteItem. The transform completes at S3 Processed; Lambda Loader is responsible for loading DynamoDB after detecting new Parquet files.

item.title: Create S3 Data Zones
item.description:
Create three separate S3 buckets: Raw, Processed, and Static Website. Raw and Processed buckets remain non-public; the Website bucket is publicly exposed via CloudFront/S3 website hosting.

Create Buckets

Step Action Technical Details
1 Amazon S3 → Create bucket Create Raw Bucket
2 Enter name stock-screener-raw-your-name
3 Select Region ap-southeast-1 or the Region you use for Glue
4 Retain Block Public Access Raw data remains non-public
5 Repeat Create stock-screener-processed-your-name
6 Repeat Create stock-screener-web-your-name for frontend

Prefix Contract

# Raw
raw_us_market/YYYY/MM/DD/us_prices_raw.parquet
raw_us_market/YYYY/MM/DD/us_company_info.parquet
raw_us_market/YYYY/MM/DD/us_financials_raw.parquet

# Processed
processed_qmj/as_of_date=YYYY-MM-DD/part-*.snappy.parquet

# Static frontend
index.html
assets/

item.title: Create IAM Roles by Least Privilege
item.description:
Create dedicated IAM Roles for AWS Glue, Lambda Loader, Lambda Reader, and EventBridge Scheduler. Do not hardcode Access Keys in Python scripts.

Role Matrix

Role Used By Least Privilege
AWSGlueServiceRole-StockScreener Daily Ingestion and QMJ Transformation Read/Write Raw, Read/Write Processed
LambdaQMJLoaderRole Lambda S3 trigger List/Get QMJ Parquet, dynamodb:BatchWriteItem, CloudWatch Logs
LambdaStockScreenerReaderRole Lambda Reader dynamodb:Query, CloudWatch Logs
EventBridgeSchedulerStockScreenerRole EventBridge Scheduler glue:StartJobRun for Daily Ingestion Job

Architectural Principle – Strict boundary per IAM role. QMJ Transform does not require DynamoDB permissions because the source code only writes Processed Parquet. Lambda Loader is the only service with batch write permissions to qmj_screener.
